Hi Amir, Alex — apologies for the delay. Quick answers and proposed plan so we can close this week:

1) EUR settlement: Redwood uses a partner bank for SEPA receipts. We will provide an IBAN and reference string (GF-INV-7890) so funds clear immediately. Expect 1 business day post-transfer.

2) Withholding/VAT: For NL entities, we can provide a withholding confirmation template (attached) but do not gross-up automatically. If GreenForge is required to withhold, please remit net and send the certificate; we will accept a certified government withholding receipt as credit against the invoice. If you prefer, we can issue a self-billing VAT invoice — let us know.

3) Escrow: Our standard escrow partner is LedgerTrust (document attached). Fee estimate: 0.35% of transaction value (min €150). If procurement prefers escrow, please confirm in writing and we’ll kick off onboarding (KYC ~3–5 business days). Note escrow is only needed if your legal team requires a third-party holdback for contract signature; otherwise SEPA + remittance is quickest.

Proposed immediate path (recommended to avoid month-end delay):
- GreenForge does SEPA for full invoice amount to Redwood IBAN by 2026-11-23 OR
- If GreenForge must split: SEPA for 70% to IBAN by 2026-11-23 and card for remainder (we’ll send a secure card link).

Please confirm which option you choose. I’ve attached the IBAN instructions, withholding_template.pdf and LedgerTrust-overview.pdf. Once we get confirmation, Alex will send the payment link or escrow onboarding steps.
